name: incorrectly_ignored_dts_file_from_projec_e9bcbe6e
subject: Fix incorrectly ignored dts file from project reference for resolution (#62438)
not_strict_reasons: no failing case added by the fix

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: For project references, a referenced project's .d.ts input was wrongly skipped before computing output mapping, so the resolution from that d.ts was ignored; the fix only skips the output computation for declaration files.

failing_cases: unittests:: tsbuild:: moduleResolution:: handles the modules and options from referenced project correctly tsc --b consumer --traceResolution -v moduleResolution:: resolution from d.ts of referenced project baseline for the tsc compiles
